title: An AI employee that works 24/7 | First Employee
excerpt: Hire an AI employee that works 24/7 on your business: describe it, and it writes and publishes a real website in about three minutes — then keeps working on it, with a receipt for every action. The build is free.
content_html:
Tell it your idea. It builds the business.

Say what the business is. It writes and publishes a real website for it, live in about three minutes — then keeps working on it.

Press Enter, or pick one below.

Free to start. No card.

How it works

How it works

You describe a business. It researches the idea, names the company, writes the pages and puts them live on their own address — then keeps working on that business, and shows you what it did.

  1. 1. You say what the business is One or two sentences in a box. No idea yet? It reads what is public about you and proposes one.
  2. 2. It builds and publishes it It studies the market, names the company, writes the pages and puts them live. Free, about three minutes, watched.
  3. 3. It keeps working on it Improving the pages, going after search traffic, working the queue. Tell it what you want and it starts there.

See one it built ↗ — a company our employee runs for us, not a customer's.

Three minutes later, the site is live

You watch it work. It picks the name, writes the pages, checks each one and publishes it.

Cleanpricing is a company we run on the product ourselves, so you can check the work against the pictures. The build is free and the site stays up.

Then it keeps working on it

Publishing a site is the easy part. Getting people to it, and finding an offer they want, takes more than one try.

  • It reads who contacted you The contact form files every enquiry. It reads them, and what those people asked for, before deciding what to work on.
  • It writes for search Every page is checked against our own SEO rules before it goes live. A page that fails them is not published.
  • It rewrites what is not landing If nobody is getting in touch it says so, and changes the offer instead of adding another page.
  • You steer it, and nothing goes out without you Leave it a note and the next block of work starts there. Email, posts, ads and charges wait for your yes; research, drafts and pages happen on their own.

And it already knows what it is doing next

Review why the shift produced no work log entries before next session. Used tonight's budget, so the shift wrapped up here and wrote the report. Everything to this point is receipted.

Cleanpricing — a company our employee runs for us, not a customer. It has worked 5 blocks of work so far, and this was the last one.

See everything it did for that company, and what it has not achieved →

The build is free. How much work it gets through after that is what your plan sets. See the plans →

You can check every step

Every action writes a row: the time, the tool, the result and the model that ran. Rows are appended and never edited.

How the ledger works →

What is switched on, and what is not

We would rather tell you what is not ready than let you find out.

  • Take payments on your own Stripe Connect an account in your own name and your site can charge customers. The money goes from your buyer to your bank. We never hold a balance, so there is nothing for us to freeze or cap. Built — switching on as soon as Stripe approves our platform
  • Reply to the people who contact you Your company gets its own inbox, and the contact form files real leads. Your employee drafts the reply and holds it until you say send. Live — drafts wait for your approval
  • Move it to your own domain Start on the address it builds you, and take the site to a domain you own whenever you want. We run a registrar, so we do it at cost. On request
  • Run ads and outbound, once you allow it On the managed plan we run the growth side with you, on an ad account you own, so the pixel and the history stay yours if you leave. Managed plan — we set it up with you, not a self-serve switch yet
  • Sell products from the site It writes pages that say what you sell and take an enquiry. There is no catalogue, no basket and no checkout, so it cannot take an order for you. Not built yet
  • Take over a site you already have Today it starts a new one. Tell it what your business does and it works from that. Not built yet

You keep custody of your money

We are not free either: the managed plan takes 15% of what your company earns, and 15% to run your ads. What we do not do is hold your money. Your customer pays into your own Stripe account and Stripe settles our share at the transaction, so there is no holding period and no withdrawal cap here.

Cut of your revenue15%, or 0% self-managed20%, no opt-out
Of your ad budget, reaches the ad platform85% managed, all of it self-managedFour fifths
Holds your moneyNever14 days
Withdrawal limitNoneCapped every calendar month
Whose ad accountYoursTheirs, shared
Trains AI on your businessNoYes, irrevocably
Learns what works across every site it runsYes — the playbook every build is checked against—
Receipt ledgerFull, exportable—

Read their terms, then read ours →

Questions

What do I get for free?

The build. It names the company, writes a multi-page site with a working contact form, and puts it live on its own address in about three minutes. That site stays up. The work that comes after is what a plan buys.

What exactly is a shift?

One block of work. Your employee reads where the company stands, picks up whatever you left it, does the work, writes you a report, and lines up what it wants to do next. How many it gets through is what your plan sets.

How do I know it actually did the work?

Every action writes a receipt: the tool it used, what changed, which model ran, how long it took, and a link to what it produced. The ledger is append-only and you can export it as CSV or JSON.

Can it spend my money or email people without asking?

No. Sending email, posting publicly, running ads and charging a customer are all held for your approval. Reversible work happens on its own.

Do you take a percentage of my revenue?

On self-managed, no — the monthly price and nothing else. On managed we take 15% of what the company earns and 15% to run your ads. What we never do on either plan is hold your money: your customer pays into your own Stripe account and Stripe settles our share at the transaction, which is why there is no holding period and no withdrawal cap here.

Do I own what it makes?

Yes — the pages, the copy, the domain and the data. Export the whole thing whenever you want. We do not train models on your business.

Hire your first employee

The build is free and takes about three minutes. No waitlist, no demo call.

Build mine now

See the plans →

它是如何运作的

您描述了一项业务。 它研究这个想法，为公司命名，编写页面并将它们放在自己的地址上 - 然后继续致力于该业务，并向您展示它做了什么。

  1. 1. 你说业务是什么，框里一两句话。 还不知道吗？ 它会读取有关您的公开信息并提出建议。

三分钟后，网站上线

你看着它工作。 它选择名称、编写页面、检查每一页并发布。

Cleanpricing 是我们自己经营该产品的公司，因此您可以根据图片检查工作情况。 构建是免费的，并且网站保持正常运行。

然后它继续努力

发布网站是比较容易的部分。 让人们接触并找到他们想要的报价，需要多次尝试。

  • 它会读取谁与您联系。联系表格会记录每个查询。 在决定做什么之前，它会阅读这些内容以及这些人的要求。
  • 它为搜索而编写 每个页面在上线之前都会根据我们自己的 SEO 规则进行检查。 不符合他们要求的页面不会被发布。
  • 如果没有人联系它，它会重写未登陆的内容，并更改报价而不是添加另一个页面。
  • 你驾驶它，没有你，一切都不会发生。留下一张纸条，下一个工作将从那里开始。 电子邮件、帖子、广告和费用等待您的同意；研究、草稿和页面都是自行发生的。

问题

What do I get for free?

构建。 它命名了公司，编写了一个带有工作联系表的多页网站，并在大约三分钟内将其发布在自己的地址上。 该网站保持运行。 接下来的工作就是计划所购买的。

What exactly is a shift?

一整块工作。 你的员工会阅读公司的情况，拿起你留下的任何东西，完成工作，给你写一份报告，并列出下一步要做的事情。 它能通过多少是你的计划所设定的。

How do I know it actually did the work?

每个操作都会写一个收据：它使用的工具、更改的内容、运行的模型、花费的时间以及生成内容的链接。 该分类账仅可追加，您可以将其导出为 CSV 或 JSON。

Can it spend my money or email people without asking?

不可以。发送电子邮件、公开发布、投放广告以及向客户收费都需要您的批准。 可逆功自行发生。

Do you take a percentage of my revenue?

对于自我管理，没有——每月的价格，仅此而已。 在托管方面，我们会抽取公司收入的 15%，另外 15% 会用于投放您的广告。 我们在这两种计划中都不会保留您的资金：您的客户将资金存入您自己的 Stripe 账户，Stripe 在交易中结算我们的份额，这就是为什么这里没有持有期和提款上限的原因。

Do I own what it makes?

是的——页面、副本、域和数据。 随时导出整个内容。 我们不会针对您的业务训练模型。
